The '''Ensel''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the world of [[Enselon]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Alta Ranga]] was an Ensel.<ref name="Artbook" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal species was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|blue]], pink, and tan skin, as well as their large craniums.<ref name="Artbook" />

==Society and culture==
This species hailed from a celestial body known as Enselon.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> an Ensel by the name of [[Alta Ranga]] had become a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving as a member of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]'s [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi assault team]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="BoG">{{Blog|holocron|10|Jedi Casualties: Battle of Geonosis}}</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dex-Maquette-Options.png|thumb|left|200px|George Lucas observing various potential designs for Dexter Jettster, including what would become the Ensel.]]
This species was originally designed as a maquette bust by [[John Knoll]] and team to serve as a potential design for the character [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], presented alongside twenty-three others for [[George Lucas]] to choose from. Though Lucas would eventually request to combine two of the other head sculpts to become the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] species, a handful of the unselected maquettes would be recycled into additional alien Jedi to be used in {{Film|II}},<ref name="FPtP">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=From Puppets to Pixels: Digital Characters in Episode II}}</ref> including the [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]], the [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]], and the various busts of famous and infamous Jedi displayed throughout the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], such as [[Chon Actrion/Legends|Chon Actrion]].<ref name="Episode II" />

[[File:Ensel-Maquette.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The full body Ensel maquette recycled from the rejected head sculpt.]]
This species was one of these selected, with a full-body maquette greenlit,<ref name="Artbook" /> as well as concept at created specifically for a Jedi Master of this species, Alta Ranga, designed by [[Dermot Power]].<ref name="Dermot Power">{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/star-wars-episode-2attack-of-the-clones|text=Dermot Power Concept Design - Star Wars Episode 2: Attack of the Clones|archivedate=20250214162554}}</ref> The design never actually made it into film, and no evidence that a CGI model for Alta Ranga was even created, though they would be revealed and expanded upon later within supplementary media for ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="Artbook" /> with [[Leland Chee]] confirming that Alta Ranga was present at, and survived, the First Battle of Geonosis, just not onscreen.<ref name="BoG" />
